text: Ukraine reportedly hit the Kerch (Crimean) bridge and launched its largest drone attack on Russia of the war, including Moscow. Reported Nov 16; damage and casualty details are not yet confirmed.

judge.comment: Wording preserves 'reportedly' and states details are unconfirmed; matches tracker digest and event.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine reportedly hit Kerch bridge
Largest drone attack on Russia since the war began, including Moscow

text: Russian airstrikes on a Ukrainian aid hub reportedly killed 72 people, and the rescue site was struck nine more times, per UNITED24 Media. Single-outlet figure as of Nov 17; independent confirmation not yet logged.

judge.comment: Significant event but the casualty figure rests on a single outlet (UNITED24 Media) and is marked 'reportedly'; a human should confirm sourcing before publishing.

factChecks.claim: 72 killed in airstrikes on aid hub
rescue site struck nine more times

text: The US is moving to curb remote access to Nvidia's advanced AI chips; the Trump administration has ordered Commerce to close the loophole (Nov 17). Context: China reportedly stalled Nvidia H200 imports on Nov 7 to favour domestic chips.

judge.comment: Both items are logged tracker events; the H200 item is carried as 'reportedly' and is worded that way.

factChecks.claim: US moves to curb remote access to Nvidia advanced AI chips
Trump administration ordered Commerce to close the loophole
China reportedly stalled Nvidia H200 imports (Nov 7)

text: How much Russian refining is offline? Ukraine's General Staff put it at 42.74% in July 2026. The IEA said losses were "more than 20%" at peak; Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%.

judge.comment: Both sides are attributed and not adjudicated, but the IEA and Reuters figures carry no as-of date in the tracker data, so a human should check provenance.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% disabled in July 2026
IEA: losses 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters: national oil processing fell 3-6%
IEA and Reuters as-of dates
factChecks.source: dates not given in tracker data

text: Ébola en la RDC: ~11,200 casos confirmados y ~5,500 muertes al 15 de nov (datos del gobierno vía Al Jazeera/Reuters). Africa CDC dice que el brote no está bajo control: más del 80% de los casos nuevos no estaban en listas de contactos.

judge.comment: Spanish version of the verified English digest; figures unchanged.

factChecks.claim: ~11,200 casos confirmados al 15 de nov
~5,500 muertes
Africa CDC: más del 80% de casos nuevos fuera de listas de contactos

text: How much Russian refining is out? Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% of capacity disabled (July 2026). IEA: losses "more than 20%" at peak. Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3–6%, as undamaged refineries offset losses.

judge.comment: Both positions are stated with attribution and no adjudication, but the IEA and Reuters figures carry no as-of date in the tracker data, so a human should confirm them before posting.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%
Undamaged refineries partially offset losses

text: A Russian missile crashed in Poland during a Russian attack on Ukraine. PM Tusk says it hit while Ukraine's allies were holding a military exercise; Warsaw calls it a provocation. Tracker count of confirmed NATO incursion incidents: 34+ before this event.

judge.comment: Directly reflects the tracker's Nov 20 event and digest, attributes the characterisation to Tusk and Warsaw. Detail beyond the digest is deliberately omitted.

factChecks.claim: Russian missile crashed in Poland during attack on Ukraine
Tusk says it hit as allies held an exercise; Warsaw calls it a provocation
34+ confirmed incursion incidents

text: Saudi Arabia confirms a Houthi attack damaged Riyadh's tallest building. The Houthis claim they struck the HQ of a wealth fund. Separately, they have told airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, warning of coming attacks. Claims are not independently verified.

judge.comment: Both sides' statements are attributed and match the tracker events. Escalation context is limited to what the data records.

factChecks.claim: Saudi Arabia confirmed Houthi attack damaged Riyadh's tallest building
Houthis claim strike on wealth fund HQ
Houthis told airlines to avoid Saudi airspace

text: How many of Lebanon's dead are fighters? Israel puts Hezbollah losses at roughly 1,700-2,500. Lebanon's health ministry counts 4,386 dead since 2 March with no civilian/combatant split. Hezbollah publishes no totals. Nobody's figures reconcile.

judge.comment: Contested-type tweets need human review. Both positions are attributed; the Israeli range comes from the tracker's disputed-figures entry (IDF / independent estimates).

factChecks.claim: Israel: ~1,700-2,500 Hezbollah killed
Lebanese MoH: 4,386 killed cumulative since 2 Mar, no civilian/combatant split
Hezbollah publishes no totals

text: UN: at least 372 Ukrainian civilians were killed in October, and glide-bomb deaths doubled. On Nov 20, Kushner said Trump is 'open to the idea' of NATO protection for Ukraine, a day after the APEC trilateral produced a 'peace declaration' without a breakthrough.

judge.comment: All figures and statements come from the tracker's dated events with attribution.

factChecks.claim: UN: at least 372 civilians killed in October; glide-bomb deaths doubled
Kushner: Trump 'open to the idea' of NATO protection for Ukraine
APEC trilateral issued 'peace declaration' without breakthrough
